fit_reason: Whole 1989 Sea Ray 260 cuddy powerboat listed by a private owner in the boats by owner section.
findings: Cuddy cabin cluttered with fishing rods, tackle boxes, bags and gear on the berth cushions and floor
Gelcoat on the bow deck and hull sides looks somewhat flat and dull in places rather than deeply glossy
Cockpit side panel and gunwale area show light grime and dust around the rod holder and storage opening
Cabin carpet and upholstered berth cushions look like they could use a cleaning
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the 1989 Sea Ray 260 Cuddy on the Rainy River. The hull and deck gelcoat look a little flat in the photos, and the cuddy cabin has a lot of gear in it that hides the berths and carpet. We do pre-sale details and gelcoat polish and can come to the dock. Would you like a quote?
